changes: Phase 3 (final): Story Recall. core/story-recall.ts (pure leaf) — buildStoryProfile + scoreSimilarity (multi-field Jaccard over keywords/fileKinds/touchpoints + type/phase boosts, symmetric/deterministic, no-NaN) + recallSimilarStories (most-similar-first, top-N, zero-score dropped, self excluded, stable tiebreak). handlers/recall.ts read-only CLI: recall --story <id> / --query "..." / --top, reusing the existing story_list (StoryStore) scan. NO FTS, NO derived index, NO embedding. recall command registered readOnly (registry/cli-engine/command-policy/config); --story and --storyId both accepted. Writes nothing, touches no gate.
usage: lattice recall --story <id> --top 5 (ranked similar prior stories + match reasons + notable findings/decisions/outcome); lattice recall --query "worker schedule". Proof: npm --prefix packages/main run test:experience-layer-recall (=> 'smoke passed').
expectedOutcome: recall --story prints a ranked top-N list with reasons; --query returns keyword-matched stories; recall writes nothing and creates no derived index. Smoke 'smoke passed' (24/24); verifier TOTAL 38 | PASS 38 | FAIL 0; existing experience-layer smokes still green.
actualTranscript: recall smoke TOTAL 24 | PASS 24 | FAIL 0 'smoke passed'. verifier TOTAL 38 | PASS 38 | FAIL 0 (buildOk recallSmoke noRegression readOnly recallIso noFts cmdRegistered pkgScript all true; regression sig/pb/hint ok). validate 38/38 covered. node bin/lattice.js recall --story B-1480 --top 3 returns ranked matches (B-9b8f/B-de86/B-8448). Reviews round 1: quality/concept PASS; behavior F-001 (--story CLI flag bug); test-coverage F-002 (100+ candidate ranking) + F-003 (malformed-profile no-crash). After fix 605d5123 round 2: all 4 PASS. Escalation required (3/2) -> degraded 3x1 fallback recorded.
outcomeDiff: No difference — structured recall delivered read-only over the story_list scan; three findings (the --story CLI flag bug + two coverage gaps) fixed and re-reviewed clean.
limitations: Structured-overlap (Jaccard) ranking, not semantic — a derived index/embedding is a future optimization only when scan size justifies it (the plan's cut-FTS decision). Playbook-sourced and finding-signal hints in reviewer prompts are surfaced by Phase 1.5; this recall is a separate read-only query surface. Phase 4 cross-project aggregation remains future/out of scope — this completes the local Experience Layer build (Phases 1a/1b/1.5/2/3).
pitfalls: A CLI alias (recall --story) must be in the zod schema or parseFlags strips it (was F-001) — verify aliases at the real CLI, not only via direct handler calls. Recall must stay read-only (no writes, no derived index) — snapshot .lattice before/after to prove it. High-finding round -> escalation quorum required; degraded 3x1 must bind to the DONE materialHash; DONE evidence-freshness needs re-validate (not just refresh_stale).
